_comment: THIS REPO IS PUBLIC. The `mimir` MCP server is deliberately ABSENT here: its config in gobot/.mcp.json carries MIMIR_SHARED_SECRET and MIMIR_USER_ID inline, and committing those to a public repo would publish them. A session working ON mimir has the service on localhost:4200 anyway and does not need the proxy. Do not copy gobot/.mcp.json here wholesale. (DEV-825 follow-up, 2026-08-22.)
